_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — every quote is an exact substring of the cited page of data/demo/project_report.md (pages split on '---' lines, numbered from 1)

decisions.title: Remove duplicate images and impute missing labels before training
decisions.rationale: Duplicate images could leak between the training and test sets and inflate the scores; missing labels were imputed from clear radiologist notes so that usable images were not thrown away.
alternatives: Keep duplicates and train on the raw data
Drop every image with a missing label

source_refs.quote: We removed duplicate images and imputed missing labels before training, because duplicates could leak between the training and test sets and inflate our scores.

decisions.title: Use Random Forest instead of Logistic Regression as baseline
decisions.rationale: Random Forest captures non-linear interactions between features without manual feature engineering; Logistic Regression was faster and more interpretable but scored clearly lower on validation.

source_refs.quote: We chose Random Forest instead of Logistic Regression as our baseline because it captured non-linear interactions between features without manual feature engineering.

decisions.title: Use F1 instead of accuracy as headline metric (class imbalance)
decisions.rationale: With about 12% positive images, a model that always predicts 'no finding' reaches about 88% accuracy while detecting nothing; F1 combines precision and recall on the minority class, so it only rises when positives are actually found.

source_refs.quote: We report F1 instead of accuracy as our headline metric because of the class imbalance.

decisions.title: Use a stratified train/val/test split
decisions.rationale: Stratification keeps the same share of positive images in every subset; a random split could leave the small test set with very few positives and make F1 unstable.

source_refs.quote: We used a stratified train/validation/test split (70/15/15) so that each subset keeps the same share of positive images as the full dataset.

decisions.title: Report a limitation: model not tested on images from other hospitals
decisions.rationale: All images come from one hospital and one scanner type, so the team cannot claim the model generalises to other scanners or patient populations without external validation.
alternatives: Claim general performance without external validation

source_refs.quote: The model was not tested on images from other hospitals, so we cannot claim it generalises to different scanners or patient populations.
